en: Vintage postcard showing a black‑and‑white (hand-colored work) photograph of a rocky creek flowing through a wooded area. Large boulders and trees line the stream. The printed caption at the bottom reads "A California Creek Scene." Additional vertical text credits the publisher in Los Angeles, California, and notes printing in Germany. A handwritten number appears near the caption.
